changes: A video's page now gathers every copy your chats hold, however the copies' names are spelled: the count on the page matches what search finds
Search keeps asking your chats behind its first answers, so copies in chats that used to stay out of search appear too
Copies of one video posted under different spellings of its name now stand as one entry, with its parts kept apart and in order
A new yellow logo, on the home screen, on the television and everywhere the app shows its mark; search rows for a known video now stand by its poster
A show's page now shows the total copies held across its episodes
Copy lists in the player and on the page now show the languages a copy's post names in its caption, not only the ones in its file name
Subtitle translation no longer shows the original line while it works: a line stays blank until its translation is ready
Copies whose names carry an HC subtitle tag, line audio or clean audio now hide with the cam copies; they can be shown again in Settings, Playback
notes: Every spelling of a video on one page, search that reaches every chat, a new yellow logo, and HC copies hidden with the cam copies.
